You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From b0b59b0056acd6f157a04cc895f7e24692fb08aa Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Nicolas Dichtel <nicolas.dichtel@6wind.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2015 16:24:26 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] selinux/nlmsg: add XFRM_MSG_REPORT

This command is missing.

Fixes: 97a64b4577ae ("[XFRM]: Introduce XFRM_MSG_REPORT.")
Reported-by: Stephen Smalley <sds@tycho.nsa.gov>
Signed-off-by: Nicolas Dichtel <nicolas.dichtel@6wind.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>
---
 security/selinux/nlmsgtab.c | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/security/selinux/nlmsgtab.c b/security/selinux/nlmsgtab.c
index 4e21b72dd709..7d49312b30e1 100644
--- a/security/selinux/nlmsgtab.c
+++ b/security/selinux/nlmsgtab.c
@@ -103,6 +103,7 @@ static struct nlmsg_perm nlmsg_xfrm_perms[] =
 	{ XFRM_MSG_FLUSHPOLICY,	NETLINK_XFRM_SOCKET__NLMSG_WRITE },
 	{ XFRM_MSG_NEWAE,	NETLINK_XFRM_SOCKET__NLMSG_WRITE },
 	{ XFRM_MSG_GETAE,	NETLINK_XFRM_SOCKET__NLMSG_READ  },
+	{ XFRM_MSG_REPORT,	NETLINK_XFRM_SOCKET__NLMSG_READ  },
 	{ XFRM_MSG_NEWSADINFO,	NETLINK_XFRM_SOCKET__NLMSG_READ  },
 	{ XFRM_MSG_GETSADINFO,	NETLINK_XFRM_SOCKET__NLMSG_READ  },
 	{ XFRM_MSG_NEWSPDINFO,	NETLINK_XFRM_SOCKET__NLMSG_WRITE },
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by the absence of the `XFRM_MSG_REPORT` command in the SELinux Netlink message permissions table, which is necessary for proper handling of XFRM (IPsec) messages. This omission led to potential security policy violations or failures in processing related messages, as the system did not recognize or allow the `XFRM_MSG_REPORT` command. The patch adds this missing command to ensure that the SELinux security framework can correctly manage permissions for this message type.

You are a programming expert.
    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.
    You need to extract the code statements that lead to the bug from  the patch, based on the root cause.

    
    Provide a response strictly in the following format:
    Code statements:
    <text1>
    <text2>
    <text3>
    <text4>
    ...
    <textN>

Root cause:
The bug was caused by the absence of the `XFRM_MSG_REPORT` command in the SELinux Netlink message permissions table, which is necessary for proper handling of XFRM (IPsec) messages. This omission led to potential security policy violations or failures in processing related messages, as the system did not recognize or allow the `XFRM_MSG_REPORT` command. The patch adds this missing command to ensure that the SELinux security framework can correctly manage permissions for this message type.
